bio: Eliott Rodriguez is an American journalist, former television news anchor, and political candidate. The son of Cuban immigrants, Rodriguez was in journalism for almost five decades including 25 years at CBS News Miami. He won three Emmy Awards, four Edward R. Murrow Awards, and a Silver Circle Award from the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences.
